Designed with a comic book-style, cel-shaded presentation, the game incorporates single-player and multiplayer game modes. PS5:sniper-elite-5.d: Sniper Elite 5 is a 2022 third-person tactical shooter stealth video game developed and published by Rebellion Developments. It is the sequel to Sniper Elite 4. It was released on 26 May 2022 for Microsoft Windows, PlayStation 4, PlayStation 5, Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S. It takes place in France during World War II. A sequel, Sniper Elite: Resistance was released on 30 January 2025.

PC:abandon-ship.d: Abandon Ship is a strategy video game developed by Fireblade Software and published 2018 for Windows and in 2019 for Mac and Linux by Plug In Digital. Set in the Age of Sail, the player manages a ship's crew as they explore the ocean and fight other ships and mythological monsters. Development of Abandon Ship was led by Gary Burchall, a former member of Climax Studios. The game received average to mixed reviews from critics, with many reviewers comparing it with the 2012 game FTL: Faster Than Light.

PC:always-sometimes-monsters.d: Always Sometimes Monsters is a 2014 role-playing video game developed by Canadian studio Vagabond Dog and published by Devolver Digital for Microsoft Windows. A later update using the MonoGame framework brought the game to OS X and Linux on 8 January 2015, iOS and Android on 28 May 2015 and PlayStation 4 on 10 October 2017. After Vagabond Dog acquired the publishing rights to the game, a port to the Nintendo Switch were released. The game puts players in the role of an author who receives notice that the love of their life is marrying someone else across the country within a month.

C64:arkanoid-revenge-of-doh.d: Arkanoid: Revenge of Doh is a 1987 block breaker video game developed and published by Taito for arcades. It is the sequel to Arkanoid. It was ported to the Family Computer and various personal computers. Hamster Corporation released the game as part of their Arcade Archives series for the Nintendo Switch and PlayStation 4, as well as their Arcade Archives 2 series for the Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X/S in September 2026.

C64:spirit-of-stones.d: Spirit of the Stones is an action video game for the Commodore 64, set on the Isle of Wight and based on an armchair treasure hunt book of the same name by John Howard Worsley. Worsley's Spirit of the Stones book was published in 1983. As with other contemporary armchair treasure hunts, Worsley hid 40 talismen and the larger Great Wight Eye diamond talisman in locations around the Isle of Wight, and included cryptic clues to their locations in the book. By 1993, 19 of the talismen and the Great Wight Eye had been found; four more were found later.
